offering_description.value: RBC Bearings designs and manufactures precision bearings and mechanical power transmission equipment for industrial machinery makers, distributors, and plant operators. It also builds bearings, flight control components, and fluid control assemblies for aircraft, spacecraft, and defense systems. It sells directly to equipment makers and government customers and through distributors to the replacement market.

primary_products.value: Precision bearings; mechanical power transmission equipment; flight control components; hydraulic and fluid control assemblies; precision machined parts

primary_services.value: Component repair and overhaul; industrial field service

customer_segment.value: B2B: Industrial machinery makers, plant operators, parts distributors, aircraft manufacturers, and defense contractors; B2G: U.S. military and other government procurement agencies

end_markets.value: Industrial machinery and material handling; mining and aggregates; food and beverage processing; commercial aviation; defense and space

revenue_model.value: product sales: Standard and custom components for original equipment and replacement parts; service fees: Component repair, overhaul, and industrial field work

value_chain_position.value: component supplier: Turns metals and purchased parts into bearings and assemblies for machinery, aircraft, and defense equipment makers; OEM / manufacturer: Builds gear reducers and mounted bearing units for machinery makers, distributors, and plant operators; service provider: Repairs and overhauls components for equipment operators
value_chain_position.category: component supplier; OEM / manufacturer; service provider

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia, and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: Industrial bearings and power transmission equipment, aerospace bearings, flight controls, and fluid control assemblies

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Direct supply to machinery makers, aerospace and defense manufacturers, and government procurement agencies; distributors / dealers: Industrial power transmission and bearing distributors, aerospace aftermarket parts distributors

regulatory_exposure.value: high: FAA approval requirements for certain aircraft parts and repair operations, U.S. export controls on defense items
